mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.status, f.sync_status AS syncStatus, f.sync_error AS syncError, f.delete_requested AS deleteRequested, sync_task.status AS syncTaskStatus, sync_task.operation AS syncOperation, COALESCE(sync_task.attempts, 0) AS syncAttempts, sync_task.next_attempt_at AS syncNextAttemptAt, sync_task.updated_time AS syncUpdatedTime, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, f.user_name AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, t.type, t.protocol FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id LEFT JOIN forward_sync_outbox sync_task ON sync_task.id = ( SELECT MAX(latest_sync.id) FROM forward_sync_outbox latest_sync WHERE latest_sync.forward_id = f.id ) WHERE (f.delete_requested = 0 OR sync_task.id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY f.created_time DESC

SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.status, f.sync_status AS syncStatus, f.sync_error AS syncError, f.delete_requested AS deleteRequested, sync_task.status AS syncTaskStatus, sync_task.operation AS syncOperation, COALESCE(sync_task.attempts, 0) AS syncAttempts, sync_task.next_attempt_at AS syncNextAttemptAt, sync_task.updated_time AS syncUpdatedTime, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, f.user_name AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, t.type, t.protocol FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id LEFT JOIN forward_sync_outbox sync_task ON sync_task.id = ( SELECT MAX(latest_sync.id) FROM forward_sync_outbox latest_sync WHERE latest_sync.forward_id = f.id ) WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND (f.delete_requested = 0 OR sync_task.id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY f.created_time DESC
